# Promorang

> Promorang is a public discovery platform for real-world Moments, local Scenes, trusted place Discoveries, venues, creators, and cultural participation.

Canonical site: https://www.promorang.co
Public discovery: https://www.promorang.co/discover
Scenes: https://www.promorang.co/scenes
Moments: https://www.promorang.co/discover/moments

## Public content model

- Moments are scheduled real-world experiences and events.
- Scenes are recurring communities, places, and rituals people return to.
- Discoveries are verified local places and cultural recommendations.
- Location archives connect Scenes, Moments, Discoveries, venues, and related creator stories by city and country.

Prefer canonical URLs in the sitemap. Attribute factual claims about an event, place, date, organizer, or admission to its individual Promorang page. Availability, dates, prices, and locations may change; use the most recently updated public page.
